info.title: NEAR Proof Arena API
info.description: Public API (default port 8471) and internal worker API (`/internal/v1`, separate listener, default port 8472). Contracts: docs/CONTRACTS.md. All candidate-provided strings are sanitized plain text.

get.summary: List registered challenges (integrity re-verified on every read)

post.summary: Upload a candidate package (raw body, content-addressed, size/quota limited)
Submit a package for a challenge (idempotent per agent + idempotency_key)

get.summary: Server-sent events of the submission's pipeline (event kinds: stage, gate, decision, log, progress, done). Each `data:` is an EventPayload JSON. Resume with Last-Event-ID or ?after=.
Signed judge report of the latest decided run (ed25519 over JCS bytes of `report`)

post.summary: Cancel the pending run (own submissions only)

get.summary: Leaderboard: ranked entries (formal tier, ADMITTED, accepted, not revoked; by score desc) first, then every other submission with rank=null and tier/decision/revoked labels. ?board=speed (default) ranks by the speed score; ?board=cost_v1 ranks by the cost score (only challenges with scoring.kind = cost_v1; every entry carries board = cost_v1 and the per-class cost breakdown). Scores of different kinds are never merged.

404.description: unknown challenge, or no cost board

post.summary: Register a challenge; the signature must verify under a governance key over the JCS bytes; id/digest recomputed
Open/close a challenge for new submissions
Revoke a score with a public reason (history preserved)
Re-run a submission as a new immutable run record
Invalidate formal cache entries by checker image and/or assumption id
Create an agent; returns its token once
Register a worker (bwrap-dev is always capped to demo)
Worker API (port 8472): lease the next job this worker may run
Worker API: extend a lease; `cancelled=true` means stop
Worker API: report the job result

422.description: invalid result (counted as an infra failure) or artifact not uploaded

post.summary: Worker API: report an infrastructure failure (bounded retries)

get.summary: Worker API: download an object by digest

put.summary: Worker API: upload an object; the body must hash to the path digest

oneOf.description: Classical PPT adversary. Nothing in this profile implies post-quantum security.

cost.description: Cost-board result for `scoring.kind = cost_v1` challenges (v1.5, additive). Never compared with `score_milli` (a speed score).

score_ci_milli.description: Half-width of a bootstrap 95% interval, milli units.

toolchain_image.description: Build sandbox image/rootfs digest or id, if reported.

BuildOutputs.description: Outputs of the judge-run build (and judge-run `prepare`).

build_ns.description: Judge-measured wall time of one build, ns (informational).

bundle.description: Tree digest of the complete built bundle (all build outputs).

bundle_archive.description: Content-store digest (raw bytes) of the deterministic tar of the bundle whose TreeDigest is `bundle`; later stages fetch it by this digest and re-check the TreeDigest.

certificate_decl.description: Lean constant named by the manifest's `[formal].certificate` (empty if none).

formal_tree.description: Tree digest of the candidate's `formal/` Lean project.

native_verifier.description: `verify_route = "native-lean"`: content-store digest of the judge-built native verifier (reported by FORMAL_CHECK, set by the control plane); later stages run this binary, never the candidate's `verify`.

public_archive.description: Content-store digest of the deterministic tar of the judge-run `public_dir` (TreeDigest `public_artifacts`).

public_artifacts.description: Tree digest of `public_dir` produced by the judge-run `prepare`, frozen by digest.

toolchain_image.description: Build sandbox image/rootfs digest or id (informational).

verifier_bytecode.description: `verify_route = "npai-v1"`: digest of the built `entry.verifier_bytecode` file. Required for that route (the server refuses to derive a verified surface without it).

CandidateManifest.description: Parsed `candidate.toml`. Every field is a *claim* the judge validates.

coverage.description: Coverage tiers (v1.7, additive; absent ⇒ not serialized, so existing challenge ids are unchanged). docs/CONTRACTS.md §11.

formal_params.description: Formal admission-statement parameters (v1.2, additive; absent ⇒ not serialized, so existing challenge ids are unchanged).

not_applicable_gates.description: Gates that may be `NOT_APPLICABLE` under this challenge (e.g. FORMAL_ZK for validity-only profiles).

scoring.description: Scoring kind and, for `cost_v1`, the pinned price model and reference cost components (v1.5, additive; absent ⇒ `speed` and not serialized, so existing challenge ids are unchanged). docs/BENCHMARK_SPEC.md §14.

ChangeClass.description: Change classification, computed by the judge (never trusted from the agent).

abstained.description: v1.7 (coverage-tiered challenges only): `prove` answered `UNSUPPORTED` in this class, so it carries no timing (all time fields 0) and is excluded from the score with the weights renormalized (BENCHMARK_SPEC §17).

proof_bytes_runs.description: Per measured run: Σ proof bytes of the batch (v1.5, additive).

verify_runs_ns.description: Per measured run (same order as `runs_ns`): Σ verify wall ns of the batch's proofs (v1.5, additive; empty in older results).

CostBaselineClass.description: Reference-candidate cost components of one class, measured under the challenge's procedure (component medians over measured runs; one run = one batch of `batch_size` requests).

proof_bytes.description: Median Σ proof bytes per batch.

prove_ns.description: Median Σ prove wall ns per batch; must equal `workload_suite.baseline_ns`.

verify_ns.description: Median Σ verify wall ns per batch, on `verifier_vcpus` CPUs.

CostClass.description: Cost components of one class (component medians, integer femto-USD per batch run). `*_fusd` validator terms already include the `N_v` factor.

heldout.description: Committed held-out cases (absent when the worker ran none).

per_class.description: Keyed by workload class id; public fixtures without a class are tallied under [`FIXTURES_KEY`] (not a class: excluded from `share_ppm`).

share_ppm.description: Weight-averaged proven fraction over the challenge's workload classes, in parts per million (contracts carry no floating point).

soundness_lift.description: Trusted Lean lemma lifting tier soundness to the statement, e.g. `NearSpecV3.sound_lift`.

statement_spec.description: Lean declaration of the top `ChallengeSpec` (the statement every admitted verifier is sound for), e.g. `NearSpecV3.challengeSpecChunkTop`.

tiers.description: Tiers in any order; `rank` is the total order (higher = larger domain).

classes.description: Workload classes this tier is complete for: an abstention on a positive case of one of them is `COVERAGE_GAP_IN_TIER`.

params.description: Lean declaration (term) of the tier's `ChallengeParams`, e.g. `NearSpecV3.challengeParamsChunk .d0`. The judge's per-tier Expected template (formal-checker config `tiers`) instantiates exactly this.

tier_cap.description: Highest challenge tier this worker may be leased.

token.description: Shown once; only its sha256 is stored.

oneOf.description: Only tested (differential/fuzz); NOT a substitute for a formal arrow.

declared_tier.description: Coverage tier the candidate is complete for (v1.7, additive): required iff the challenge has `coverage` (checked against the challenge by the judge, `ChallengeDefinition::declared_tier`). docs/CONTRACTS.md §11.

verifier_bytecode.description: Built NPAI image (relative path among `build.outputs`), required iff `verify_route = "npai-v1"`.

verify_route.description: How the arena runs verification (v1.2, additive). `native` (default): the built `verify` executable. `npai-v1`: the arena's own NPAI interpreter runs `verifier_bytecode` (docs/INTERP_SPEC.md); `prepare` must then emit exactly `public_dir/public.bin`. `native-lean`: the judge builds `verify` itself from the Lean model `formal.verifier_model` with the governed Lean compiler (the candidate's binary is not used).

EventPayload.description: Data of one SSE event (`id:` = event id, `event:` = kind).

public.description: Whether this artifact may be shown publicly (held-out data must not).

ExecJob.description: Payload shared by the post-build execution stages.

ExecutionInfo.description: How (and with what isolation) a result was produced. Results produced by the `bwrap-dev` sandbox or by any simulated component must carry `tier_cap = demo`.

error.description: Infrastructure error description (sanitized and bounded by the server).

FormalParams.description: Parameters of the judge-built admission statement that are not resource limits of the sandbox (`ArenaCore.ChallengeParams`). Optional so that challenges without a formal statement (demo) keep their ids.

max_proof_bytes.description: Honest proof-size bound used by `VerifierComplete` (`ChallengeParams.maxProofBytes`); must equal `resource_limits.max_proof_bytes`.

max_reduction_fuel.description: Fuel cap of an explicit standard-model security reduction (`ChallengeParams.maxReductionFuel`).

verify_fuel.description: NPAI fuel given to the approved interpreter for one `verify` call (`ChallengeParams.verifyFuel`).

certificate.description: Lean constant whose *type* the judge constructs; candidate supplies the value.

verifier_model.description: `native-lean` route (v1.2, optional): the candidate-defined verifier model `ArenaCore.OracleVerifier` (e.g. `Candidate.Model.verify`) that the judge splices into the expected statement and compiles into `verify`.

relation_decl.description: Fully qualified Lean name of the relation, e.g. `NearSpec.TransferV1.NearRelation`.

relation_module.description: Lean module that defines `NearRelation` for this challenge.

tree_digest.description: Tree digest of `spec/lean` + `formal-core` sources the challenge was frozen against.

gate.description: Gate id; equals the obligation id for obligation gates.

reused_from.description: Set when the result was reused from a parent via the content-addressed cache.

cancelled.description: The run was cancelled: stop work and do not call `/complete`.

InvocationMode.description: Sandbox-instance granularity of steady-state benchmark runs.

oneOf.description: bench-spec-v1: every `prove` invocation in its own fresh sandbox instance (a microVM boot per request is inside nothing timed, but the guest page cache is cold for every invocation).

bench-spec-v1.1: each measured batch runs in ONE fresh sandbox instance; every request is still a fresh process with a wiped scratch, only its own inputs and no state carried between requests. One untimed warm-up invocation on the batch's first request precedes the timed ones. Cold runs stay one instance per invocation.

JobContext.description: Context common to every job of a run.

package_digest.description: Digest of the uploaded candidate package archive (fetch via the artifact API).

tier.description: Tier of the challenge. A worker whose sandbox cannot satisfy this tier must refuse the job (the control plane never leases it to one).

JobKind.description: Kind of a pipeline stage job.

JobResult.description: Everything a worker reports for one job.

artifacts.description: Artifacts produced (logs, transcripts, exports...), already uploaded via the artifact API.

benchmark.description: Required for `BENCHMARK` jobs that measured something.

coverage.description: CONFORMANCE on a coverage-tiered challenge (contracts v1.7): the declared tier's proven coverage (CONTRACTS §11).

gates.description: Gate results for gates owned by this job kind.

log_excerpt.description: Short plain-text log excerpt shown publicly (sanitized, bounded to 16 KiB by the server). Must not contain held-out data.

manifest.description: Required for a passing `VALIDATE` job: the parsed, validated manifest.

native_verifier.description: FORMAL_CHECK, `native-lean` route: content-store digest of the judge-built native verifier (uploaded before `complete`).

JobSpec.description: A leased job specification, tagged by kind.

board.description: Which board `rank` belongs to: `speed` (default) or `cost_v1` (additive, v1.5).

challenge_id.description: The challenge this result was measured under (additive, v1.4). A result is never re-labelled or moved to another challenge's board.

cost.description: Per-class cost components, so the board shows why (v1.5).

cost_score_milli.description: Cost-board score and its CI (cost_v1 challenges only; v1.5).

declared_tier.description: Declared coverage tier; the board orders by its rank first.

protocol_version.description: That challenge's NEAR protocol version (additive, v1.4).

score_ci_milli.description: Half-width of the score's 95% interval, milli units (additive, v1.1).

superseded_by.description: Set when the challenge has been superseded: the board is historical (frozen, closed for new submissions) and scores are not comparable with the successor's (additive, v1.4).

kinds.description: Job kinds this worker can run (empty = any).

lease_seconds.description: Requested lease duration (server clamps to its configured bounds).

lease_id.description: Fencing token: must be presented on heartbeat/complete/fail. A new lease (e.g. after expiry) invalidates older lease ids.

stage.description: Pipeline stage / job kind the log belongs to.

invocation_mode.description: How benchmark invocations are isolated (v1.4, additive; absent ⇒ `vm_per_invocation`, i.e. bench-spec-v1, and not serialized, so existing challenge ids are unchanged). See docs/BENCHMARK_SPEC.md §4.

outlier_mad_k.description: Runs farther than this many MADs from the median are flagged (not dropped).

PriceModel.description:
`arena-price-model-v1`: integers only, femto-USD. Per-chunk system cost of one proved request (docs/BENCHMARK_SPEC.md §14.2):

```text C = c_cpu·vcpus_p·T_prove + c_cpu·vcpus_p·T_prepare·/A + N_v · ( c_cpu·vcpus_v·T_verify + (c_bw + c_store)·proof_bytes ) ```

bandwidth_fusd_per_byte.description: `c_bw`: network cost per proof byte per validator.

cpu_fusd_per_vcpu_second.description: `c_cpu`: price of one vCPU for one second (prover and validator).

prepare_amortization_requests.description: `A`: requests over which one `prepare` is amortized; 0 = `prepare` is not charged (reported only, bench-spec-v1 §2).

status.description: `draft` (never pinned by a signed challenge) or `governed`.

storage_fusd_per_byte.description: `c_store`: retention cost per proof byte per validator (0 = none).

validators_per_chunk.description: `N_v`: validators that each verify every chunk's proof (stateless validation fan-out). ≥ 1.

verifier_vcpus.description: vCPUs of the reference validator profile; `verify` is measured pinned to this many of the benchmark CPUs and charged for them. ≥ 1 and ≤ the challenge's `hardware_profile.vcpus`.

PriceRationale.description: Why a price-model parameter has its value (part of the hashed object, so the rationale cannot be edited without a new version).

basis.description: `protocol` (read from pinned nearcore), `published` (public price list / docs), or `estimate` (a modelling choice).

param.description: Field name of the parameter, e.g. `validators_per_chunk`.

oneOf.description: v1.7 (coverage-tiered challenges): `prove` answered `UNSUPPORTED` on a positive case of a class its declared tier is complete for.

signature.description: ed25519 signature (hex or base64) over the JCS bytes of `definition` by a configured governance key.

created.description: `false` if the identical challenge was already registered.

oneOf.description: bench-spec-v1 §8: weighted geometric mean of prove-time speedups.
bench-spec §14: weighted geometric mean of per-class system-cost ratios under a pinned [`PriceModel`].

cost_baseline_prepare_ns.description: Reference candidate's `prepare` wall ns (only charged when `prepare_amortization_requests > 0`).

price_model_digest.description: JCS sha256 of `price_model`; shown on every cost-board row.

verify_statistic.description: Aggregation of per-run verify totals (v1.6, additive; absent = `median`). `cost_baseline.verify_ns` is pinned with the same statistic.

allowed_assumptions.description: Ids into `security/assumptions/*.json`; each pins an exact Lean declaration.

excludes.description: Properties explicitly NOT established by an admitted proof.

public_key.description: Hex ed25519 public key of the control plane's report key.

revocation.description: Revocation recorded after the report was issued (not covered by the signature).

signature.description: Hex signature over the canonical (JCS) bytes of `report`.

governance_key.description: Hex ed25519 governance key that signed the definition.

signature.description: Hex signature over the JCS bytes of `definition`.

superseded_by.description: Id of a registered challenge whose `supersedes` names this one. A superseded challenge is closed for new submissions; its results and board stay attached to it (docs/PROTOCOL_UPGRADES.md §5).

accepted.description: `null` while pending; `true` only if every mandatory gate passed.

artifacts.description: Public artifacts produced by the judge for this run.

assumptions.description: Assumptions the admission may rely on (the challenge's security profile).

coverage.description: Coverage-tiered challenges: the declared tier and proven coverage (CONTRACTS §11).

logs.description: Bounded, sanitized plain-text log excerpts (never HTML).

trusted_base.description: Trusted computing base entries the result depends on.

verified_surface.description: Verified-surface digests (set once the judge build completed).

idempotency_key.description: Unique per agent; `[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,128}`. Replaying the same key with the same body returns the original submission; a different body is a 409.

oneOf.description: Official ranked board; all formal obligations mandatory.
Tests + diagnostic timings only; never ranked as formal.
Plumbing demonstration; simulated components allowed, always labelled DEMO.

allowed_packages.description: Allowed Lean package imports: name -> pinned git commit.

axiom_allowlist.description: Exact logical axioms permitted (fully qualified names).

checker_image.description: Digest of the formal checker image (rootfs) used for clean rechecks.

recheckers.description: Independent kernel recheckers that must all accept, e.g. `lean4checker`, `nanoda`.

VerifiedSurface.description: The digests that define the *verified* surface. If all are equal between a child and its parent, formal results may be reused (`ProverOnly`).

verifier_bytecode.description: `npai-v1`: SHA-256 digest of the built verifier bytecode image.

verify_route.description: Effective verify route (`native` when the manifest omits it).

VerifyStatistic.description: How the per-run verify totals of a class are aggregated into the `V` component of the cost (docs/BENCHMARK_SPEC.md §14.3; contracts v1.6).

oneOf.description: `median_u64` (bench-spec-v1.2 / v1.3; the meaning of an absent field).
`lower_quartile_u64`: the order statistic at index ⌊(n−1)/4⌋ of the sorted runs (bench-spec-v1.4).

batch_size.description: Number of requests per measured batch.

generator.description: Digest of the generator spec (fresh inputs are sampled after freeze).

weight_ppm.description: Weight in parts-per-million; all weights in a suite sum to 1_000_000.

baseline_submission.description: Baseline candidate submission id and per-class baseline medians (ns).

heldout_commitment.description: Commitment to the held-out set (digest of its tree), revealed at season end.

public_fixtures.description: Public dev fixtures (tree digest). Held-out and fresh inputs are not listed here.
